scope: Independent read-only raw evidence and source review. Only this JSON written; no archived durable-history reacceptance.
finding: Both archived normal-entry allow turns return successful macro_run with input_sequence action_sent=true/event_count=2, but the same-trace turn_summary.irreversible is empty. Existing 31-case approval/receiver/audit assertions passed without testing this classification requirement.

mechanism.classification: 02f-turn-effect-kinds.js IRREVERSIBLE_BRIDGED_KIND omits macro_run, batch_actions, input_sequence and focus_window; irreversibleToolKind returns empty for these names. Bare nested tool names also fail its bare!==original bridge guard.
mechanism.summary: 02-session-store.js:3035-3050 unwraps only the tool_invoke proxy, calls noteIrreversible once with outer macro name, and never examines actual returned results steps. Result parsing only sets row ok after a name has matched.
mechanism.compoundSchema: batch.py _run_batch caps requests at200 and returns results[{step,tool,ok,result|error}]. Returned records include validation failures as well as invoked steps, so presence or ok:false alone is not dispatched-action proof.
mechanism.preexisting: 02f entire file and buildTurnSummary body are unchanged between96db15f6 and7f95d654. This gap predates the provider-history fix.
mechanism.displayBoundary: 09-workflow.js:3580-3582 stores boundToolResultForDisplay output in toolCalls; line3882 builds the summary from that display copy. Compound evidence may be truncated before classification.

boundedFixRecommendation.scope: Support direct input_sequence and actual returned macro_run/batch_actions steps through known ACC schemas; do not label every compound tool desktop just by outer name.
boundedFixRecommendation.evidenceSource: Derive a small bounded effect projection from original execution results before destructive display shrinking; never infer completed steps from requested macro args. Alternatively report evidence incomplete/unknown when only a truncated result remains.
boundedFixRecommendation.bounds: Allowlist ACC envelopes and leaf kinds; cap parsed bytes/depth/steps and output rows (existing50 ledger rows), preserve step/call attribution, avoid double counting. Handle bare nested names only in the verified compound context, not arbitrary objects named tool.
boundedFixRecommendation.positive: Known action_sent=true remains a desktop effect even when enclosing macro or verification later fails/cancels. Include other known successful desktop leaves such as focus_window only using their own truthful executed/acted contract.
boundedFixRecommendation.negative: Pure wait, readonly-only, empty, prevalidation-rejected, denied, pending-cancel before dispatch and explicit not_dispatched calls must produce no confirmed desktop-action row. A named step or ok:false by itself proves neither dispatch nor no effect.
boundedFixRecommendation.unknown: Preserve explicit uncertain/partial outcomes as possible effects with unknown status; never silently turn unknown into no-effect or completed-success. action_sent=false alone is not universal proof against another leaf effect or completed prefix. Unknown/truncated results must not invent confirmed leaves.
boundedFixRecommendation.ledgerMeaning: User-facing irreversible ledger describes known or explicitly possible effects outside journal rollback. It is not proof of application-level success, an exhaustive effect history, or a promise that desktop actions can be globally undone. Preserve that distinction through session folds/UI instead of reducing unknown to ok:true.
futureValidationOnly: Actual same-turn summary for direct input_sequence and macro input plus focus
Wait/readonly/empty macros and deny/pending-cancel/not_dispatched: no confirmed desktop row
Failed/cancelled compound after known dispatched input: preserve effect
Unknown or truncated compound: explicit possible/incomplete evidence, no fabricated success
Bounds, bridge/proxy/bare nested attribution and summary folding preserve unknown semantics
